SELECT u.id,
    u.email,
    u.user_name,
    u.display_name,
    u.avatar,
    u.first_name,
    u.last_name,
    u.is_admin,
    u.is_persona,
    u.persona_config,
    u.created_at,
    u.people_discoverable
   FROM users u
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM users requesting_user
          WHERE requesting_user.id = auth.uid() AND requesting_user.is_admin IS TRUE));

SELECT social_posts.id,
    social_posts.user_id,
    social_posts.content,
    social_posts.post_type,
    social_posts.rating,
    social_posts.progress,
    social_posts.created_at,
    social_posts.updated_at,
    social_posts.likes_count,
    social_posts.comments_count,
    social_posts.media_title,
    social_posts.media_type,
    social_posts.media_creator,
    social_posts.image_url,
    social_posts.media_external_id,
    social_posts.media_external_source,
    social_posts.media_description,
    social_posts.visibility
   FROM social_posts
  WHERE social_posts.visibility = 'public'::text;

SELECT u.id,
    u.user_name,
    u.display_name,
    u.avatar,
    u.first_name,
    u.last_name
   FROM users u;

SELECT sp.id,
    sp.content,
    sp.post_type,
    sp.created_at,
    sp.likes_count,
    sp.comments_count,
    sp.user_id,
    u.user_name AS username,
    u.display_name,
    u.avatar
   FROM social_posts sp
     LEFT JOIN users u ON sp.user_id = u.id
  ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC;

WITH all_activity AS (
         SELECT user_sessions.user_id,
            COALESCE(user_sessions.ended_at, user_sessions.last_heartbeat, user_sessions.started_at) AS last_activity_at,
            'session'::text AS activity_type
           FROM user_sessions
        UNION ALL
         SELECT list_items.user_id,
            list_items.created_at AS last_activity_at,
            'list_add'::text AS activity_type
           FROM list_items
        UNION ALL
         SELECT social_posts.user_id,
            social_posts.created_at AS last_activity_at,
            'post'::text AS activity_type
           FROM social_posts
        )
 SELECT all_activity.user_id,
    max(all_activity.last_activity_at) AS last_activity_at,
    count(*) AS total_activities
   FROM all_activity
  GROUP BY all_activity.user_id;
